request.prompt: Instrumental high-altitude synthwave for an arcade kart race over a mountain pass at blue-hour dusk, aurora overhead, above a sea of clouds. 118 BPM, D minor. Pulsing analog bass, wide shimmering pads, bright plucked arpeggios, a soaring lead with a little choir-like air, tight electronic drums with a steady drive. Cool, epic and hopeful, constant energy so it can loop under a race. No intro, no breakdown, no ending, no fade-out, no vocals.
